name: Mojimoji Chibikko Mahou Gakuen ~Itaku Shicha Iyada yo~
original_name: もじもじちびっ子魔法学園～痛くしちゃイヤだヨ～
source:
The tyrant king is overthrown by the rebellion of the slave nation. He uses past correction device to return to the childhood and correct the personality of rebellion leader to turn her into a loyal slave.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/08/vn-of-month-november-2004-planetarian.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
暴君国王被奴隶民族的起义推翻。他利用过去修正装置回到童年，修正叛军首领的人格，将其变成忠诚的奴隶。

[出自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/08/vn-of-month-november-2004-planetarian.html]vndbreview[/url]]
